sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 1.4.3
sources.claim: Normal text 4.5:1; large text 3:1; logo exception.
sources.short_quote: The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 1.4.11
sources.claim: Essential graphics and active controls 3:1; threshold uses unrounded values.
sources.short_quote: Ensure meaningful visual cues achieve 3:1 against the background.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 1.4.1
sources.claim: Do not rely on color alone.
sources.short_quote: Color is not the only way of distinguishing information.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 2.3.3
sources.claim: AAA interaction animation can be disabled unless essential.
sources.short_quote: Motion animation triggered by interaction can be disabled, unless the animation is essential to the functionality or the information being conveyed.

sources.title: Arabic and Persian Layout Requirements
sources.claim: Arabic RTL; numerals LTR; contextual shaping.
sources.short_quote: Arabic script is written from right to left.

sources.title: Arabic and Persian Layout Requirements current editors draft
sources.claim: Do not emulate Latin tracking in Arabic; allow ascenders/descenders.
sources.short_quote: These instances do not correspond to letter-spacing in non-cursive scripts, however.

sources.title: Unicode Bidi Algorithm basics
sources.short_quote: Numbers following RTL text in a LTR context need to be isolated from the preceding text.

sources.title: Structural markup and RTL in HTML
sources.claim: HTML dir attribute; logical CSS properties.
sources.short_quote: Never use CSS to apply the base direction.
